data.one_liner: Build native Apple CarPlay and Android Auto interfaces from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to render native Apple CarPlay and Android Auto UI templates using platform-specific models while sharing core app logic. It provides controllers, callbacks, and connection listeners for in-car displays.
use_when: You need to extend an existing Flutter application to support Apple CarPlay or Android Auto.
You want to render native car platform templates from Dart instead of scaling the mobile UI.
avoid_when: You are building a standalone Android Automotive OS application rather than an Android Auto projection app.
You expect to render arbitrary custom Flutter widgets inside the car display instead of native platform templates.
strengths: Supports both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto from a single Flutter application.
Binds to native car platform templates and callbacks.
Includes support for navigation, images, incremental updates, and voice states.
weaknesses: Car hosts restrict template appearance and available controls based on app category and entitlements.
Requires complex native setup including shared engine configurations on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 14.0+ deployment target, custom shared-engine AppDelegate and SceneDelegate setup on iOS, and appropriate entitlements for CarPlay and Android Auto.
